title: Highly recommend!
text: Adrian was an excellent guide. He seemed to know everyone we passed on the street. He gave us a lot of insight into Barcelona and the food and drink we were tasting. Highly recommend!
author: Cindy_M

title: A "must-do" if you're in Barcelona
text: Adrian, our guide, was brilliant. Even though this was my sixth time in Barcelona, Adrian shared so much about the history, what to do and where. Good mix of different places to eat, drink and visit. Kept kids and adults entertained alike. I'm glad we did this the day after we arrived, as it gave us a list of places to visit and things to do over the following days. Totally worth it.
author: Omair_M

title: Fun and informative!
text: This was a very culturally enriching experience! The guide Adrian took us to some really great local spots for authentic tapas and local wine, all were very tasty! I’d recommend this tour and, even do it again myself!
author: Deena_B

title: A tour not to be missed!
text: We had a great tour with Adrian. He was a terrific guide and shared so much about the food and customs and  the historical context that made it even more interesting! Adrian’s warmth, energy and sense of humor made thisevent one not to be missed!
author: 188candaceb

title: Great way to start the evening and get a taste of the local cuisine
text: Great Food Tour.  Adrian knows the town and the places to go.  We had a wide range of local food and wine and all the recommendations were spot on.  We even ent to a couple of the spots recommended on the tour and they were great as well.  Highly recommend this tour!
author: Ken_H

title: Great food, great spots
text: Adrian was great, gave us the history plus current-day inside tips on where to eat, shop and avoid. Super interesting history. The food and drinks were great!
author: Jill_N

title: Tapas tour
text: It was great fun going to each location for tapas and wine with historical highlights along the way!
author: Mary_S

title: Informative, tasty and fun!
text: We really enjoyed our food tour around Barcelona, visiting bars and experiencing food we would not have known to try. Our guide, Adrian, was very knowledgeable about the local history and traditions and expertly guided us around. We enjoyed it so much, we went back to experience a couple of the venues on our own the following day.
author: 387debbiet

title: The Beat tour & Guide
text: Our tour Guide Adrienne was excellent. He was so knowledgeable & fun! He introduced us to the most delicious food and drink. A wonderful introduction to the history & culture of Barcelona. An A+
author: Dana_B

title: Knowledgeable noshing
text: The trip was fabulous!  Adrian was super knowledgeable and friendly.  We learned a lot and the food was amazing. He taught us not just history but also about Catalan culture.
author: 951rondam
